steps.body: A sum can be acted out: start with a group of children, then let more children join them.
steps.narration: A sum can be acted out: start with a group of children, then let more children join them.

widget.prompt: 3 children are playing. 2 more join. Hop to show how many are playing now.

commonLandings.feedback: That never moved. Two more children joined, so the count grows past 3.
That hopped only once. Two children joined, so hop twice.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 3 and count on 2: you land on 5.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 5 — 3 children and 2 more make 5.

predict.prompt: 3 children are playing. 2 more join. Which way does the count move?
predict.reveal: Children joining makes the group bigger, so the count moves up the number line. If the 2 had gone home instead, the count would slide the other way.
